expectedBehavior: The action reads Mark Review for an Active Sprint and reads Close Sprint only when the Sprint is already in Review.
observedBehavior: In AgileCockpit's Sprint & Epic tab, the Sprint Work / Close Eligibility action is labeled Close Sprint while the selected Sprint is Active; activating it transitions the Sprint to Review.
reproductionSteps: 1. Open Sprint & Epic. 2. Select an Active Sprint. 3. View the Sprint Work / Close Eligibility action label.

workItem.title: Correct Sprint close-action label for active Sprints
